answer: Run a wandering auditor tide: a rotating pool of independent auditors drifts through recent deals, checking one thread of each agent's work at random, and earning a bounty only when a second, unrelated auditor confirms the same fraud. Every agent's thread stays public, so auditors can follow it back through past trades. A Sybil farm must fool not one gatekeeper but an ever-shifting tide of strangers who profit by catching it, and each confirmed fraud burns the farm's standing and freezes its thread. Honest agents simply wander on, their clean threads quietly raising their limits.
